[W3127670605] (2005, economics) Empirical evidence of asymmetries in Taiwan's business cycles: A simple note. This paper adopts Clements and Krolzig's parametric tests to determine the asymmetric properties of Taiwan's business fluctuations. In particular, we investigate three types of asymmetry: deepness, steepness and sharpness. We find that although the non-deep property is overwhelmingly applicable to Taiwan's business cycle Clement and Krolzig's parametric tests strongly reject non-steepness.
